pages.title: Cardinal Shard
pages.text: A piece of how many there are, even when there are infinitely many. Cardinals measure the size of a set rather than its order. The shard is uniform and solid and feels like a count without a sequence.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Ordinal Hounds dropped these, and I found more in Hilbert's Hotel and the Ordinal Spire. They measured how big a set was, regardless of how it was ordered.
